basics.name: Ediyono
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years building payment systems and complex integrations end to end, from architecture and API design to hands-on delivery on AWS and Kubernetes. Grew from Senior Engineer to Tech Lead and Engineering Manager on Xendit's regional payouts platform, then returned to hands-on IC work by choice. Recently building agentic AI systems that plan, code and ship software.

work.name: Xendit Pte. Ltd.
highlights: Led design and delivery of regional payment products across SEA markets, end to end with product and engineering teams.

work.name: Xendit Pte. Ltd.
highlights: Stayed hands-on as architect of the payout routing re-architecture: redesigned multi-currency routing, cutting new region/currency rollout from 2 months to 2 weeks.
Led 4 sub-teams (~16 engineers across ID, MY, SG and PH) on regional payout products; owned roadmap and prioritisation with product managers.

work.name: Xendit Pte. Ltd.
highlights: Designed scalable payout architecture for customers' high-volume transactions (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, DDD) and built the multi-currency regional disbursement API.
Re-architected bank-partner integrations into a hybrid monolith, cutting new partner onboarding from 6–8 to 3–4 weeks.
Led the EKS migration of disbursement microservices: deployment time −80%, infra cost −40%.

work.name: Xendit Pte. Ltd.
highlights: Scaled batch payouts to handle 10x traffic and introduced an internal batch API for multi-payment processing.

work.name: Deloitte Digital SEA
highlights: Designed and delivered complex system-integration solutions end to end (Azure, MuleSoft, API Gateway, .NET), coordinating off-shore and on-site teams.

work.name: Traveloka
highlights: Built and automated integration pipelines between product systems and Finance & Accounting (AWS, Java, Node.js).

work.name: Accenture
highlights: Developed end-to-end systems and customised third-party applications to client requirements (IBM Cognos TM1, AWS, Heroku, ASP.NET, Node.js SPA / hybrid mobile apps).

projects.name: OpenClaw Multi-Agent AI System
projects.description: Self-hosted system of 5 specialised Claude agents (architect, programmer, analyst, scout, assistant) that plan, code, review and merge PRs across 6 repos, plus daily automated research digests and financial-report parsing.

projects.name: IDX Financial Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive dashboard for analysing IDX-listed companies. React, TypeScript, Material-UI, Recharts.

projects.name: IDX Report Ingestion Pipeline
projects.description: Job-queued agent pipeline: a Claude analyst agent parses IDX financial-report PDFs into per-period JSON, writes rated analyses (bear/base/bull targets) and daily watchlist news, all feeding the IDX Financial Dashboard via auto-merged PRs.

projects.name: Store Inventory Manager
projects.description: Multi-location inventory app in production for a retail business. Next.js, TypeScript, Google Sheets, Vercel.
